verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows generic API-key headers (application ID + API key) for REST auth and that the hosted MCP server enforces an OAuth-protected-resource flow with bearer tokens, which implies some credential gating for agent access but never documents Algolia's key-scoping/ACL mechanism explicitly for AI agents. missing for 10: explicit docs on issuing restricted/least-privilege API keys (index/action-scoped ACLs) for agents, key revocation/audit workflow, and any hands-on confirmation of scoped-key enforcement.
